title: Promote proven learning into stronger repo-native owners

intent.outcome: Proven learning selects one stronger existing repo-native owner operation under evidence, authority, latitude, revision, and cost constraints; completed promotion proves the owner and subtracts duplicate provisional residue while unsafe or target-specific cases remain correctly bounded.
non_goals: Create a universal promotion store, mutation command, or policy engine.
Authorize canonical mutation from recurrence count, one success, or agent inference alone.
Delete durable anti-rediscovery rationale whose value survives stronger-owner promotion.

parent.contribution: Move evidenced learning out of provisional context into the strongest existing owner and subtract obsolete residue.

effects: Promotion decisions refer to existing target-specific operations and never invent a generic mutation surface.
Completed promotions require revision-bound proof and produce an explicit retain/shrink/stub/delete subtraction decision.

delegation.reason: Session policy explicitly prohibits spawning sub-agents; promotion builds sequentially on the same operating-decision contract.

next_action: Implement the promotion and subtraction compiler, compose it into operating decisions, and prove deterministic, procedural, human-authority, target-specific, durable-advisory, unsafe, and quiet cases.

claims: Promote proven learning into stronger repo-native owners is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
